1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Bb4 4.Qc2 Nc6 5.N.strategy: Unpins the knight, so that a capture on c3 can be answered with the bishop and the queen can stay on c2. White avoids the doubled pawns it feared and is ready to close the centre if Black pushes in the middle.
